description: This line plot illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers of a neural network, specifically comparing four distinct output types: attn_output, attn_residual, ff_n_output, and ff_n_residual, as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer index, ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of five units. The vertical axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," is scaled linearly and spans from 0 to 1600. The blue dashed line, representing attn_output, begins near zero, rises gradually to approximately 900 at layer 20, and then continues to increase slightly beyond. The orange dotted line, attn_residual, starts near zero, rises sharply to a peak of about 1600 at layer 1, then declines to around 1000 by layer 5 before rising again to approximately 1400 by layer 20. The green dashed line, ff_n_output, begins near zero, rises steeply to about 1200 at layer 2, then declines sharply to near zero by layer 5, and subsequently rises again to approximately 600 by layer 20. The red solid line, ff_n_residual, starts near zero, rises sharply to approximately 1600 at layer 1, then declines to around 1000 by layer 5 before rising again to approximately 1400 by layer 20.
